newsitem.title: USA: NeXstar's DaunoXome used against lymphoma.
newsitem.headline: NeXstar's DaunoXome used against lymphoma.

text.p: NeXstar Pharmaceuticals, Inc said on Thursday that a team of independent investigators found DaunoXome, its anti-cancer agent, was successful in treating non-Hodgkin's lymphoma patients who had failed other types of cancer therapy.

DaunoXome, or liposomal daunorubicin citrate for injection, had already been approved as a primary therapy for treating Kaposi's sarcoma, a form of skin cancer contracted by AIDs patients, in the United States, Canada and parts of Europe, but was now being tested to treat other types of cancer, NeXstar said.

Some patients with low-grade and intermediate-grade non-Hodgkin's lymphoma, who had failed previous chemotherapy treatments, responded to DaunoXome, the comany said and the size of their tumors was reduced.
